newsitem.title: USA: ITT in definitive pact to sell MSG stake.
newsitem.headline: ITT in definitive pact to sell MSG stake.

text.p: ITT Corp on Wednesday said it has signed a definitive agreement to sell its 50 percent interest in Madison Square Garden to Cablevision Systems Corp
The transaction is expected to be completed in June.
The firms reached agreement in principle in March.
In addition to the previous agreement, ITT has agreed to contribute an ITT-owned aircraft which MSG has used for the New York Knicks and New York Rangers sports teams.
To pay for the aircraft, Cablevision will add another $19 million to each of two previously announced $75 million purchase options contained in the deal.
ITT said Cablevision has received a commitment letter from Chase Manhattan Corp's Chase Manhattan Bank for funding for the purchase.
